title: Riverside Cliffside City
description: A sprawling fantasy city built along a canal at the base of towering white cliffs. The illuminated multi-story buildings with shops, arched architecture, and a large cracked mural are visible at dusk, with boats docked along the waterway and figures scattered throughout the cobblestone streets.
prompt: Wide cinematic view of a detailed fantasy city built along a canal at the foot of massive white cliffs at dusk. Multi-story European-style buildings with glowing shop windows line the cobblestone street, boats are moored along the water, people walk the paths, a large cracked mural appears on one building, with towers and bridges carved into the rocky cliffs above, atmospheric twilight lighting, rich colors and textures.
